summary.headline: CrowdWorks: XRP Fund No. 1 becomes largest shareholder via KRW 9.0bn rights issue, 12.68% stake
summary.what_happened: On Feb 6, 2026, XRP Fund No. 1 (엑스알피1호조합) became CrowdWorks' largest shareholder through a third-party private placement rights issue, taking a 12.68% stake from former largest shareholder Park Min-woo and related party Kim Woo-seung. The acquirer's stated purpose is management participation, with planned replacement of existing executives and appointment of new ones; the purchase was financed by a loan from Shinbanks Co., Ltd. This corrective filing (dated Nov 27, 2026) amends the funding-method description, and the fund's financial figures are reported as of the original submission date.

key_numbers.label: Fund's total capital (as stated in filing)

summary.why_it_matters: A change in largest shareholder in Korea typically signals a possible shift in control or management direction, and it often comes with announced plans to replace executives. Shareholders generally look at the acquirer's funding source, any lock-up on newly issued shares, and whether the new holder intends to participate in management.
